Leaflet 1.9.4 (stable), BSD-2-Clause. License retained in LICENSE.

Pinned distribution from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/ .
Official installation and stable-version documentation: https://leafletjs.com/download.html .

The trip page uses numbered div markers, so Leaflet's default marker/layer images are not required.
OpenStreetMap attribution is visible on the map. Tiles are requested only after the map becomes visible and use the browser's normal cache and Referer behaviour. No offline tile downloads or bulk prefetching are implemented.
